framing: This incident analysis addresses a 62-minute deployment window during which 6 of 14 regions experienced deploy job failures. The root cause was traced to a certificate rotation event at the start of the window, which invalidated artifact signatures for deployed packages in affected regions. Fourteen regions are served by the Cartographer fleet; only six were impacted. A total of 41 failed jobs occurred across these regions. Two unrelated coincident changes—specifically, an object-store lifecycle purge and a 600-second bundle cache refresh—are excluded from causal attribution based on evidence. The incident did not involve customer-facing services or external systems. All timeline entries are timestamped in ISO 8601 UTC format and include a description and evidence source string. A severity classification is applied using the published rubric: customer impact first, then internal blast radius, then mitigation time. This artifact does not assign blame to symptoms or coincident events without explicit exclusion evidence. All claims are traceable to supplied evidence, stated assumptions, or marked gaps. The process described here is idempotent and halts on ambiguous inputs with a diagnostic naming the offending input. No new top-level keys are introduced beyond those required by contract.
